b1-review-5.R5.1 A night of jazz:
Danny: What a great band! I'm so glad we came back.
Bruno: Me too. And they're bound to play that samba song again. It's their best one.
Ana: Hi guys! Sorry I'm late. I apologize for missing the first songs. My shift ended late.
Danny: Don't worry! Sit down and help yourself to some fries.
Ana: Thanks! You're both enjoying yourselves, aren't you?
Bruno: We are! And this time we managed to get the best table. Last time we couldn't even find a seat.
Ana: So, are you going to dance tonight?
Danny: No way! Neither of us can dance. And neither of us wants to try.
Rafa: Hey everyone! Thanks for coming. You must be Ana. Danny talks about you all the time.
Ana: Hi Rafa! Your band sounds amazing. How long have you been playing with them?
Rafa: About a year. Last year I was stuck in a rut. I called my brother, and he asked me what I really wanted. I told him I missed music. And he told me to stop complaining and join a band!
Danny: Good advice!
Rafa: Yes. If I hadn't called him, I wouldn't have joined the band.
Bruno: And if you hadn't joined the band, we wouldn't have found this great bar.
Ana: Danny, I almost forgot. My grandmother loved your podcast episode. She asked me if you would visit her again next month.
Danny: How kind of her! Of course I will. She can teach me her secrets for a long life.
Rafa: Well, I'd better go. We're back on stage in five minutes. It's a great place, isn't it?
Bruno: It is. Good luck!
Danny: You know what? There's a slight chance I'll dance tonight.
Bruno: I'll believe it when I see it!
